visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A static background featuring a split screen with a yellow upper half and a white lower half displays a screenshot of an English news article from THE ELEC regarding Samsung engineers applying for SK Hynix jobs. Large Chinese text overlays are at the top and bottom. (2) A young woman with reddish-brown hair in a light blue denim jacket appears in a small circular inset at the center-left. She talks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. (3) The article remains visible with specific sections highlighted in yellow to guide the viewer's attention. The woman's inset disappears and reappears as she continues to narrate. (4) The woman reappears in the inset for the final few seconds, smiling and laughing while concluding her commentary. The yellow and white background remains constant throughout.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 三星驚現跳船潮. Samsung員工瘋搶海力士職缺!. [Logo]: emmy追劇時間. [Subtitle]: 結果現在在海力士開出了三個職缺. [Slogan]: 掌握獨家商業話題. 加入Emmy頻道會員. 鎖定最精彩的追劇. 按$超級感謝贊助我們. (2) [Subtitle]: 大家知道發生了什麼事情嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 海力士他們收到了 200個三星工程師的履歷啊. (4) [Subtitle]: 哇! 消息一出 各界嘩然. (5) [Subtitle]: 現在三星電子是發生了什麼逃命潮嗎. (6) [Logo]: THE ELEC. [Subtitle]: 刊登這個消息 韓國媒體叫做THE ELEC. (7) [Subtitle]: 他們引用業界人士的說法呢. (8) [Subtitle]: 他說呢三星電子裡面負責這個記憶體蝕刻製程的資深工程師. (9) [Subtitle]: 大概也就是在200人左右. (10) [Subtitle]: 海力士收到了200封履歷呢. (11) [Subtitle]: 這就表示三星電子裡面. (12) [Subtitle]: 符合海力士所需資格的工程師. (13) [Subtitle]: 他們全部都遞履歷都想要跑了耶. (14) [Subtitle]: 哦這太搞笑.
